response.draft:
Slide 1: Ridgeline Return Works
Paid work the week people come home
Carver Falls, Tamsen County
Request to the Pellwood Foundation: $90,000 toward our FY2027 expansion
December 2026

Slide 2: Two Years of Growth
People enrolled: 88 in FY2025, 121 in FY2026 (+38%)
Placed in permanent jobs: 47 in FY2025, 69 in FY2026 (+47%)
Completed paid crew phase: 61 to 90
Average starting wage: $17.10 to $18.25
Hiring employers: 15 to 23

Slide 3: How It Works
Paid crew work within 5 business days of intake, at $16.50/hour
Landscaping, light demolition and park cleanup contracts
Job coach helps with ID, resume, driver's license and interviews
Goal: a permanent job within 12 weeks
Support continues for 6 months after placement

Slide 4: Six-Month Job Retention
71% of FY2026 placements still employed at six months (58% in FY2025)
How we count it: 52 of 69 placements have reached six months so far
37 of those 52 confirmed employed
6 people we lost contact with are counted as not employed
We cannot say the program caused this improvement
County unemployment also fell, from 5.1% to 4.4%, and we have no comparison group

Slide 5: What FY2026 Taught Us
Most job losses happen in the first 60 days after placement
People who stayed employed were far more likely to have had 3+ coach check-ins in those 60 days
Coaches were stretched thin, and follow-up was what slipped
With one crew of 12, people waited up to 3 weeks to start
Four employers asked for more referrals than we could send

Slide 6: In His Words
"The crew paid me the first week. That's the part nobody else did. I didn't have to choose between rent and showing up."
Darnell, finished the crew phase in October, now on the night shift at Brannock Precast

Slide 7: The FY2027 Expansion: $186,000
Second crew lead and crew supervisor stipend: $72,000
Dedicated retention coach for the first 6 months on the job: $64,000
Second crew vehicle lease and equipment: $28,000
Added participant supports: $22,000
FY2027 targets: 160 enrolled, 90 placed, 75% six-month retention
Retention measured the same way, with lost contacts counted as not employed

Slide 8: Our Request
$90,000 from Pellwood: about half of the $186,000 expansion
The other $96,000 is being raised from current funders
Core FY2027 budget of $612,400 is covered by existing sources
Total FY2027 budget: $798,400

Slide 9: Careful With Every Dollar
FY2026 expenses: $612,400; revenue: $615,400; surplus: $3,000
Cost per permanent placement: about $8,875
Cost per person enrolled: about $5,060
Funded by county, two foundations, crew contracts and 312 individual gifts
Contact: Marisol Okafor-Reyes, Executive Director
